# OTR Newsletter #4: Welcome to the Fourth Edition of the Open Technology Research Newsletter!

This issue lands at a pivotal moment for our field in Europe in particular. On 3 June, the European Commission [published](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1NjkxODg3NDkyLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiYmQ0ZDM2YjdmMDhlNjZjYSJ9) its Tech Sovereignty Package, and with it the first-ever comprehensive EU Open Source Strategy, which recognises open source as a horizontal enabler of European technological sovereignty. It's an inflection point two decades in the making, and one that makes OTR's core purpose more urgent than ever: building the connections between researchers, practitioners, and policymakers needed to feed real evidence into real decisions.

On the theme of evidence and policy, our new blog post – [The Demand Side: Policymaker Perspectives on Open Technology Research](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1NzY4NDMzNTg3LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiZTQ2OWIyNmU3NGY5ZmZkMCJ9) – draws on interviews with policymakers across regions to ask what research they actually need, and why so much of it never reaches them. It's a fitting companion to the wave of community reactions to the Tech Sovereignty Package, including [OFE's own welcome](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1Nzc5OTY3OTMxLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiMjZhN2I3MmNkYTZjYzVlOSJ9) of the package and the [Open Source Initiative's](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1NzkyNTUwODUyLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiOTU3NmQyOWY3YTRmMTNkZSJ9), alongside [a more searching take](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1ODAzMDM2NjE3LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiNmNiNTllMzYyMmU4NzQxMiJ9) in [Tech Policy Press](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1ODEyNDczODEwLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiNTgxYzdmYzU1ZmRiZWM2YiJ9) on whether the Strategy truly puts open source to the test.

Finally, OTR was on the ground last week at [UN Open Source Week](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1ODIyOTU5NTc1LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiODY2ZjMxYzgzZGZiYTA5YyJ9), represented by [Duane O'Brien](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1ODM1NTQyNDk1LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiYjRkNzI2MzVhZDRkZGE0NSJ9),[Katie Steen-James](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1ODQ5MTczOTkyLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiM2JjOTZjOWYwNTdhNWM2NyJ9),[Jordan Maris](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1ODU4NjExMTgxLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiMWJjZTE5MDVjMjIyYTUwZSJ9), and[Gabriel T.](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1ODY4MDQ4MzY4LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiMTIyYTRlNDRjODBhNzE1NyJ9) from the [Open Source Initiative](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1ODgwNjMxMjkwLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiNmY4NmE5YzZhMWY3ZDFjNiJ9). ## New Open Technologies News

**Linux Foundation Releases OpenMDW-1.1; NVIDIA Adopts OpenMDW for Cosmos, Isaac GR00T, Ising and Nemotron, AI Model Families (May 2026)** – The Linux Foundation released OpenMDW-1.1, an open licensing framework designed specifically for AI model distributions, advancing open model ecosystems through permissive licensing and intellectual property protections. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1OTIwNDc2MTY1LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiZmQ1NDM4ZTAzYzk5MWFlNyJ9)

**Open Source Initiative Helps G7 Deliver Vision On AI Openness (June 2026)** – On May 29, 2026, in Paris, G7 Digital and Technology ministers approved a “Vision on AI openness opportunities and shared language”. The vision, which sets out terminology around AI openness, is the result of a three-month partnership between the OSI and the G7. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1OTI3ODE2MTk4LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiZDc4Njc1ODA3MjQwYTQwNCJ9)

**Commission proposes tech sovereignty package to strengthen Europe's digital autonomy and resilience (June 2026)**– On 3 June, the European Commission released its Tech Sovereignty Package, a set of measures to strengthen Europe's capacity in semiconductors, artificial intelligence (AI), cloud and open source. As part of this package, the EC now has, for the first time, a comprehensive strategy on open source, recognising that open source crucially contributes to Europe’s technological sovereignty, competitiveness, and innovation. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1OTM5MzUwNTM2LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiNzhlMjQ5OTgwZjhlMzFlNCJ9)

**Without Open-Source Hardware, There Is No EU Tech Sovereignty (June 2026)**– Some argue that the EU's Tech Sovereignty Package and Open Source Strategy focus too narrowly on software and treat open-source hardware – RISC-V, open EDA tools, open chip designs, and the skills to use them – as an afterthought, when openness at the physical layer is actually a prerequisite for genuine, structural tech sovereignty. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1OTQ5ODM2Mjk3LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiYTAxNGE5ZjQ4ZGQ1NDViZiJ9)

**EU praises open source for tech sovereignty – then backs W, a private for-profit microblogging platform (June 2026)**– The European Commission “joined” the new European social platform W Social, not just creating an account but migrating its entire Personal Data Server – handing its institutional identity and signing keys to a private Swedish for-profit company. This is an ironic decision, especially in the wake of the EU Open Source Strategy and given the underlying AT Protocol (an open protocol) was designed so institutions could self-host their own identity, something the EC already has the capacity to do. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1OTYxMzcwNjM1LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiNzg0ZGFkYzM3ZmMxNDc3NyJ9)

**Launch of UNESCO Open Science Platform (June 2026)** – UNESCO launched a new platform for open access to its research, released as free and open source software built on open technologies including a customised implementation of CERN's InvenioRDM, reporting that around 75% of responding member states now have open science infrastructure. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1OTcyOTA0OTc0LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiMDc4OTgzMjdhYmJmMTAzOSJ9)

**The Rousseeuw Prize for Statistics 2026 (June 2026)** – The R ProjectFive members of the R Core Team have been awarded the Rousseeuw Prize for Statistics for their decades of work building and maintaining the R Project. The R Project is a collective endeavour that has had an enormous impact on the development of statistical methodology and data analysis over the last three decades. R is a computer language and an environment for data analysis and graphics. It has become a vehicle for the development and dissemination of new methods through the establishment and maintenance of an ecosystem of well-defined software extension packages. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1OTg0NDM5MzEyLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiMDI5ZDU1MjU3NjAxY2Y5YiJ9)

**Qualcomm Bets $14 Billion on Cracking Nvidia’s AI Monopoly With RISC-V and an Open Compiler (June 2026)**– Qualcomm's confirmed Modular acquisition plus reported talks (per a 15 June report) to acquire Tenstorrent, the AI chip startup built on open RISC-V and led by Jim Keller, at an $8–10 billion valuation.  →[Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg1OTk5MTE5Mzc5LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiZWEyODZiMjA4NzIyNjA3MyJ9)

**Linux Foundation and Industry Leaders Launch Akrites to Defend Critical Open Source Software Against AI-Enabled Cyber Threats (June 2026)** – The Linux Foundation has launched a coordinated effort to harden critical OSS in the era of AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, establishing a shared Security Incident Response Team and standardised disclosure process, backed by AWS, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, IBM, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Red Hat, the Rust Foundation, and banks/telcos. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MDEzNzk5NDQ2LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiNGQxZjRkNmQ1NTZjNjFmNSJ9)

## New Open Technologies Reports and Research

### [Public sector open source program offices](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MDI0Mjg1MjA4LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiMzI1ZWYyNzE0MWY5NmY2ZSJ9) (June 2026)

Archetypes for how to grow (common) institutional capabilities (Journal of Systems and Software - November 2026): This study aims to explore how the adoption, development, and collaboration on OSS can be enabled through organisational support functions or centres of competency, also known as Open Source Programme Offices (OSPOs) within Public Sector Organisations (PSOs) in the European Union, Norway, Liechtenstein, and Iceland. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MDMzNzIyMzk0LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiZWFmOWM5YWQ3MzYxYjAwNCJ9)

### Open to open-source AI? Navigating AI model choice in public sector agencies (June 2026)

This study is the first to look at open-source AI adoption in the public sector. It includes evidence from 31 public servants in Australia, Canada and Germany. Attitudes towards open-source AI differ from those for open-source software. Technological and organisation barriers hinder greater open source AI adoption. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MDUzNjQ1MzQ2LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiOTVhOThhNDExYmUwOTEyZCJ9)

### How to Build an Open-Source Program Office (June 2026)

This document outlines a step-by-step roadmap for establishing and maturing the strategy and core functions of an Open-Source Program Office (OSPO). Its methodology reflects the IDB's operational experience, referenced publications, lessons from interviews with the global open source ecosystem, and outputs from the roundtable session “Collective Mentorship: Establishing & Sustaining Government OSPOs” held at the Digital Public Goods Alliance Annual Member Meeting in November 2025. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MDc1NjY1NDQ3LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiNDczODUwZmE2YzI0OGM4MSJ9)

### Cyber Regulation Report 2026 (June 2026)

As the UK’s House of Commons prepares for the third reading of the UK’s Cyber Bill, OpenUK shares an overview of global Cyber Regulation, including the 5 June Trump Memo calling out open source in AI. The report sets the context of this in a world of Agentic AI and the Anthropic Mythos Language Model’s effect.→ [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MDk1NTg4Mzk2LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiOGFkM2Y4ZDcwN2JlMjJjZSJ9)

### Steering open-source AI to accelerate the sustainable development goals (11 June 2026)

While the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution is advancing rapidly, the open-source paradigm offers key pathways and potential risks for accelerating progress towards the Sustainable Development Goals and beyond. This comment introduces four governance actions that consider how sustainability, evaluation, safety, and cooperation can be integrated into the transformation of open-source AI, thereby reducing uncertainties and challenges posed by open-source AI for sustainable global prosperity.→ [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MTE0NDYyNzczLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiYmFiZjkzMGU4YzhjNjE3ZSJ9)

### Commons-Governed Artificial Intelligence: A Taxonomy of Collective Governance (13 Jun 2026)

The governance of artificial intelligence is overwhelmingly theorised through two institutional frames. In the market frame, the data, models, and compute that constitute the AI stack are private goods exchanged under property and contract; in the state frame, a regulator imposes rules from above. A third possibility, the collective and self-organised stewardship of AI-relevant resources by the communities that produce and depend on them, remains comparatively under-theorised, even as it proliferates in practice through data trusts and cooperatives, federated learning consortia, public compute initiatives, open-weight model collaborations, and community data sovereignty regimes.→ [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MTM2NDgyODc3LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiMmExNGE2ZGVlZjU5OWIwOCJ9)

### AI Systems as Digital Public Goods: Evidence and Recommendations from a Multi-Stakeholder Assessment (26 June 2026)

This ADB-commissioned report, produced by United Nations University with UN ODET, examines why almost no AI systems currently meet the DPG Standard despite high-level commitments like the Global Digital Compact. Drawing on a desk review, expert interviews, and a global survey, it sets out what would need to change for "AI as Digital Public Goods" to become a workable pathway rather than just an aspirational label. → [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MTU5NTUxNTU1LFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiOTZkNTcwMDRhZjViOTNlYyJ9)

### Reimagining Open Source and Openness in AI (25–28 June 2026)

Debates over open source and openness in artificial intelligence (AI) have intensified as policymakers, researchers, and practitioners grapple with how foundation models should be developed and governed to balance innovation, accountability, and public interest. However, there has been limited empirical work examining how diverse stakeholders collectively understand and negotiate responsible openness in AI, particularly through participatory processes that extend beyond industry-led definitions and frameworks. This paper presents findings from a multi-sectoral workshop grounded in futures thinking and participatory design methods.→ [Read more](https://xwzxjde.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MzM2NjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxNjg3OTg2MTgyNjIwMjMzLFwiclwiOjE5MTY4Nzk5NzE3NTg5MTg0N30iLCJzIjoiY2IxY2JiODY5YzFkMDhhMCJ9)

## Opportunities and Tenders

## The Sovereign Tech Agency (STA) is looking for a Communications Lead (July 2026)

The STA is looking for an experienced, strategic thinker to lead and develop our communications work. Become part of the team that envisions open source as public infrastructure and is making the future possible.

## Open Call for new COST Action proposals (July 2026)

Participants are invited to submit COST Action proposals contributing to the scientific, technological, economic, cultural or societal knowledge advancement and development of Europe. Multi- and interdisciplinary proposals are encouraged.
